# Show-and-tell and co-design session plan

A 45-minute session to show colleagues what NDL PubSec MCP does, let them try it, and gather what they need. Works with the in-page checker alone, so it needs no install and no network.

NDL PubSec MCP is an independent prototype. It is not a government service and is not endorsed by any government department.

## Before the session (20 minutes)

- Run each worked example you plan to show.
- Ask attendees to bring one real metadata record or one real question about data. No personal data.
- Print or share the proto-personas and one service blueprint.

## Agenda

| Time | What | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | The problem | Who has had a record rejected, or could not find data? |
| 5 to 15 | Show it | Check a record live in the browser; show one worked example from the prompt library |
| 15 to 25 | Try it | In pairs, check one of your own records |
| 25 to 40 | Co-design | Pick the persona closest to you. Walk its journey. Mark where it would break for you, and what is missing |
| 40 to 45 | Feedback | The questions below |

## Feedback questions

1. What did you try, and did it do what you expected?
2. Which role is closest to yours, and what does it get wrong?
3. Where in the journey would you get stuck?
4. What one change would make you use it again?

Raise what you heard through the [contact form](https://github.com/cyberdudeuk/ndl-pubsec-mcp/issues/new?template=contact.yml). Do not include names or personal data.
